snippet.title: Mortality... Please - VAINSANE Fridays #11 #visualnovel #psychologicalhorror
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #11 — Mortality... Please

Penelope falls for someone with an impossible condition.. Then an elderly former fiancée arrives with his letters. A short psychological horror visual novel about growing up and choosing what to do with an impossible situation.

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Released October 9th, 2026.

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5075750/Mortality_Please/
